sources.scope: R x T; cubic local H^s wellposedness s>0, higher powers small-data scattering. Not all L2 data on R2.
Linear variable-coefficient ultrahyperbolic equation, lateral uniqueness via monotonicity and numerical scheme; no cubic all-data scattering.

Equation can be renamed/rescaled to scalar hyperbolic cubic NLS. The displayed rational G/F have equal leading numerator/denominator products, generically tending to1 along rays; they do not exhibit an L2(R2) nonscattering example. No all-data theorem.
Correction linked and latest article inspected; no matching all-L2 announcement.

registry_checks: Complete Palomar/Hexagon and pinned OpenAI/Colbrook caches searched for hyperbolic cubic/nonlinear Schroedinger aliases; no full match.
scope_comparison: Need arbitrary L2(R2) data, global CL2 with local L4 uniqueness/continuous dependence and both time scattering for the exact scalar equation. Waveguide, linear uniqueness and nonzero-background explicit waves fail these requirements.
